expected_symptom: dxc fails to compile a member function that returns or copies the whole 'this' value (not this.member) with 'cannot compile this aggregate expression yet', while FXC accepts the same construct
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Reproduces on main-debug (89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df) and on all 20 stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607, full linear scan, no invalid probes: a member function returning 'this' by value or assigning it into an out-param fails 'cannot compile this aggregate expression yet'. Source-traced to AggExprEmitter (CGExprAgg.cpp) lacking a VisitCXXThisExpr override, unlike the scalar emitter; Sema itself raises no diagnostic (existing -fsyntax-only -verify test cpp-errors.hlsl already contains the construct with no expected-error). Controls: this.member access is unaffected (no-match); the identical repro compiles cleanly with -spirv (no-match), directly confirming Keenuts's 2023 comment; FXC compiles the identical shape cleanly; hlsl_clang_trunk reproduces the byte-identical diagnostic, so the successor front end shares the gap. A narrow, unimplemented CodeGen path rather than a language-design question.
title: [feature request] Copying "this" fails
